question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Summary
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Summary"** means a brief statement or account of the main points of something. (सारांश)

 
 
• **Example: **The **summary** of the meeting was shared with all the participants via email.
 
 
 
• **"Lengthy"** refers to something that is very long in duration or extent. (लंबा)
 
 
• **Example: **The novel was so **lengthy** that it took me weeks to finish it.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Summary'** is **'lengthy'**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abrupt** (अचानक): Sudden and unexpected.

 
 
• **Example:** His **abrupt **departure left everyone in shock.
 
 
 
• **Elliptical** (अधूरा): Having an oval shape; also can mean something that is intentionally left incomplete.
 
 
• **Example:** The** elliptical** remarks made the audience curious.
 
 
 
• **Significant** (महत्वपूर्ण): Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention.
 
 
• **Example:** The discovery of the new element was **significant** for the scientific community.
